title: Radiation Processing of Food

official_sources.title: Chapter 2.13 — Radiation Processing of Food, Version 2 (07.05.2025)
FoSCoS Guidance Document V1.1 — Radiation Processed Foods are process standards, not standalone product listings

overlay_model.foscos_instruction: Select the corresponding underlying Food Category/product and apply Chapter 2.13 additionally.
engine_sequence: Resolve underlying food identity and its product standard first
Determine radiation class or allied-product class
Check minimum and maximum dose window
Verify approved/licensed irradiation facility and irradiation certificate
Re-check underlying food standard after processing
Apply pre-packaged sale and radiation-specific labelling requirements

regulatory_notes: No food may be radiation processed except as permitted by the dose tables in 2.13.1.
Class 1 covers bulbs, stem/root tubers, rhizomes and fresh spices including ginger, garlic and turmeric.
Radiation processed food must continue to comply with the underlying food standard and all other applicable FSSAI provisions.
FoSCoS does not list Radiation Processed Food as a standalone standardized product; the corresponding underlying food category is selected and the process standard applies additionally.

food_classes.foods: Bulbs, stem and root tubers, rhizomes and fresh spices including ginger, garlic and turmeric
Fresh fruits and vegetables other than Class 1
Cereals and their milled products, pulses and their milled products, nuts, oil seeds, dried fruits and their products
Fish, aquaculture, seafood and their products (fresh or frozen) and crustaceans
Meat and meat products including poultry (fresh and frozen) and eggs
Dry vegetables, seasonings, spices, condiments, dry herbs and their products, tea, coffee, cocoa and plant products
Dried foods of animal origin and their products
Ethnic foods, military rations, space foods, ready-to-eat, ready-to-cook and minimally processed foods

allied_products.product: Packaging materials for food or allied products
Health foods, dietary supplements and nutraceuticals

dosimetry.rule: Routine quantitative dosimetry shall be carried out during operation and records maintained as required by the Atomic Energy (Radiation Processing of Food and Allied Products) Rules, 2012.

facility_requirements: Irradiation facility must be approved and licensed under the Atomic Energy (Radiation Processing of Food and Allied Products) Rules, 2012.
Facility must comply with the conditions for approval, operation, licence and process control under those Rules.
Irradiation must be carried out in accordance with those Rules.
No food or irradiated food shall leave the facility without an irradiation certificate indicating dose and purpose.
restrictions: Radiation processing shall conform to the dose limit, radiation source and conditions specified for the food category.
Radiation processed food shall be identified to prevent unintended re-irradiation.
Processing shall be carried out by personnel with the prescribed qualifications and training.
Food once irradiated shall not be re-irradiated unless specifically permitted.

records.rule: Every radiation treatment shall be recorded by the facility as required under the Atomic Energy (Radiation Processing of Food and Allied Products) Rules, 2012.

underlying_food_compliance.rule: Radiation processed food shall comply with all Food Safety and Standards Act/regulation provisions specifying the standard of the underlying food.

labelling.treatment_statement_location: In close proximity to the name of the food
mandatory_fields: Batch Identification No. (BIN) as provided by facility
